description: Part single, part 2-storey infill extension to side/rear involving demolition of existing utility space.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan E197, Proposed Block Plan E198A, Existing Block Plan E199A, Proposed floorplans E200A, Existing Floorplan E201, Proposed sections E202A, Building Sections E202aRevA, Proposed elevations E203A, Proposed elevations E204A, Existing elevations E205, Existing elevations E206, Design & Access Statement, Heritage Statement, SuDS proforma, SuDS management plan, Flood Risk Assessment and CIL formReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Exempting demolition and notwithstanding the details set out in the SuDS Pro Forma, the development shall not commence until details of the Sustainable Drainage Strategy are submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include: Sizes, storage volumes, cross-sections, long-sections (where appropriate) and specifications ofall the source control SuDS measures including rain gardens, raised planters, green roofs, swale and permeable paving. Final sizes, storage volumes, invert levels, cross-sections and specifications of all site control SuDS measures including ponds, soakaways and underground tanks. Include calculations demonstrating functionality where relevantREASON : To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD 61, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPF

Notwithstanding the approved drawings, the new first floor rooflight serving the bathroom fronting Raleigh Road shall not be implemented. The new rooflights shall be of a conservation type, flush with the roof plane with minimal framing. Prior to their insertion, additional drawings that show details of proposed new rooflights by section and elevation at a scale of between 1:20 and 1:1 as appropriate shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

Prior to their use, a schedule specifying all external materials to be used shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. This schedule may, for example, include written details of manufacturer, product name or number (if applicable) and surface colour/texture together with precedent imagery at varying scales. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and permanently maintained as such. Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

The brickworks for the new extension shall match the main building. Prior to the commencement of works utilising these materials, sample panels of 1 square metre minimum shall be erected on site to show areas of new, exterior walling, and approved in writing by the local planning authority. These panels shall indicate brick size, colour, texture and bond together with mortar mix, joint size, colour and pointing profile. Upon approval the sample panels shall be retained on site for reference for the duration of works unless otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority. The works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

Notwithstanding the approved drawings, the existing window lintel on the south elevation of the main building, and the existing windows on the north elevation of the main building, shall be retained in situ and shall not be altered, replaced, or removed as part of the development.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

No soil ventilation pipes, air extraction pipes, boiler flues or ducting shall be fixed to the fabric of the building other than those shown on the approved drawings.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.
